lesson: Setting CogoPoint.LabelLocation on a label that is already dragged is applied relative to the old drag, so the label lands elsewhere. Call ResetLabelLocation() first, set LabelLocation, then read it back to verify.
CogoPoint.Bounds does not include a dragged label, and CogoPoint.Explode returns nothing through the API. Don't use either to measure point labels; never explode points.

Undragged point labels can be rotated by their label style; a dragged label is horizontal on the sheet, centered vertically on the leader end, a little past it on the side away from the point, and the leader runs point -> elbow -> short horizontal landing. Drag labels you place so their geometry is predictable.

In scripts, Entity, Surface, Section and DBObject exist in both the AutoCAD and Civil namespaces and are ambiguous: write Autodesk.AutoCAD.DatabaseServices.Entity / .DBObject, or the specific Civil type (TinSurface, ...).
The script engine does not support the C# dynamic keyword (missing Microsoft.CSharp binder). Use typed objects, tuples or anonymous types.
The ACADVER system variable includes the licensee's company name, e.g. '26.0s (Company)'. Don't print or store it; record only the release (26.0 = Civil 3D 2027).

For a twisted layout viewport, convert WCS to the sheet (DCS) with the inverse of Rotation(-ViewTwist, ViewDirection, Target) * Displacement(Target - Origin) * PlaneToWorld(ViewDirection); the view's CenterPoint, Width and Height are in DCS. Test visibility in DCS, not with WCS extents.

Viewport.CustomScale is paper units per model unit (1" = 30' is 1/30). Paper size x (1 / CustomScale) gives model size. When the user is in a layout viewport, TileMode is false and Editor.CurrentViewportObjectId is that viewport (Number >= 2).

A label or marker on a layer that is frozen, off, or frozen in the current viewport (Viewport.GetFrozenLayers) is invisible on that sheet. Leave invisible labels out of overlap checks, or they block good spots.

The point group that controls a point's displayed style is the first group in CivilDoc.PointGroups order that contains the point and overrides that style (IsPointStyleOverridden / IsPointLabelStyleOverridden). An override with a null style id means 'no marker / no label'.

After changing a point group's query (StandardPointGroupQuery, PointGroup.SetQuery), call PointGroup.Update() so its membership refreshes. IncludeNumbers is a comma-separated string; keep what was there.
Editor.SelectImplied() returns what the user currently has selected (pickfirst). Ask the user to select or trace the object they mean, then read it, instead of guessing coordinates.
